usedFor: When a status moves on a monday.com board, Craft starts the brief or notes page for that item.

bestTemplate.name: “Item Column Value Changes” in monday.com, then “Create Document” in Craft
bestTemplate.why: “Create Document” puts the new doc in a folder, Unsorted or Templates, with starting content already in it.

watchOut: Every column update fires “Item Column Value Changes”, so a busy monday.com item can open several Craft documents.
